annotations.text: The sheet is the product (docs/interface.md). Content is real: FD 36873's August 2026 record from the store. Decisions are tinted rows with the Board's own summary, sentence-cased; filings show type and the 'filed for' cell as printed. Dates quoted, never computed.
Two low-fi alternates for the typographic register only — Main is the leading candidate (serif captions + tabular sans data). Pick one, or mix: e.g. Main's structure with Ledger's density.
